visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt and grey trousers, walks towards a street-side shop from behind. They are under a large green and white beach umbrella. The background shows a busy street with parked motorcycles and distant buildings. (2) A close-up shot shows two hands pulling apart a fluffy white steamed bun, revealing a filling of minced meat, green onions, and a whole salted egg yolk. The lighting is bright and natural. (3) Several rows of steamed buns are individually packed in clear plastic bags with pink ties, sitting in yellow baskets. (4) A multi-layered stainless steel steamer is shown with steam rising around several white buns inside. A glass window reveals the interior. (5) A wooden storefront with a menu board and a pink sign with handwritten text is displayed. Green potted plants are visible on the left. (6) A female staff member wearing an orange t-shirt with a logo and a face mask is seen working behind a counter. Another staff member in the background is also wearing a mask. (7) A person's hand holds up a plastic bag containing several large steamed buns against a bright outdoor background. (8) Close-up shots show different varieties of buns being broken open: one with a yellowish mung bean paste and another with a dark red bean paste. The texture of the fillings is visible. (9) A wide shot captures the exterior of the shop titled '楊記傳統饅頭' with yellow signage and green awnings. A few people are standing near the entrance.
